title: The INF and the package
description:
Check a driver package's INF file for the fields that signing and installing need.

```
[Version] Signature="$WINDOWS NT$"       ok
[Version] Class=System                    ok
[Version] DriverVer=11/20/2026,1.0.3.0    ok
[Version] CatalogFile missing             -> required for signing
[SourceDisksFiles] xenon.sys              ok
```
hints: A line starting with `[` changes the current section; strip everything after `;` first (lesson 5.04).
`std::sscanf(value.c_str(), "%d/%d/%d,%d.%d.%d.%d", ...) == 7` checks the date and version together.
requirements: Parse sections and `key=value` lines, ignoring `;` comments.
Check the required keys in `[Version]` and that the driver file is listed.
Check that `DriverVer` has a valid date and a four-part version.
stretch: Compare two INF versions and say whether the new package would replace the old one.
